message:
Running command: cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src/jp2image.cpp", "function": "Jp2Image::readMetadata", "line": 151, "var": "box", "code": "while (io_->read(reinterpret_cast<byte*>(&box), boxHSize) == boxHSize)", "note": "Attacker-controlled JP2 file is parsed box by box; the File Type box header (length=8, type='ftyp') is read from the input."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src/jp2image.cpp", "function": "Jp2Image::readMetadata", "line": 161, "var": "box.length", "code": "enforce(box.length <= boxHSize + io_->size() - io_->tell(), ErrorCode::kerCorruptedMetadata)", "note": "box.length=8 passes the size enforcement since it is within the remaining file size."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/jp2image.cpp", "function": "Jp2Image::readMetadata", "line": 183, "var": "boxData", "code": "std::vector<byte> boxData(box.length - boxHSize)", "note": "boxData is allocated with size 8-8=0 bytes because the File Type box declares length 8 with no payload."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/jp2image.cpp", "function": "Jp2Image::readMetadata", "line": 185, "var": "boxData", "code": "if (!Internal::isValidBoxFileType(boxData))", "note": "The empty boxData vector is passed to isValidBoxFileType, triggering the vulnerable code path."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/jp2image_int.cpp", "function": "isValidBoxFileType", "line": 12, "var": "boxData.size()", "code": "if ((boxData.size() - 8u) % 4u != 0)", "note": "boxData.size()=0; subtracting 8u underflows the unsigned size_t to a huge value, so the modulo check passes incorrectly."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/jp2image_int.cpp", "function": "isValidBoxFileType", "line": 15, "var": "brand", "code": "const uint32_t brand = getULong(boxData.data(), bigEndian)", "note": "getULong reads 4 bytes from boxData.data() which points to a 0-byte buffer, causing an out-of-bounds read."}
]
EOF
echo "trace written"
